$description: UserCard (platform/patterns/UserCard, library wave 8, lane A; also the Profile card): its component tokens. The surface and padding are Card's (card-*); the avatar, badge, list and image are their own components. Nothing here adds a color.

user-card-gap.$description: User card: the space between the cover, the person, the details and the actions.

user-card-identity-gap.$description: User card: the space between the avatar and the name (default variant).

user-card-text-gap.$description: User card: the space between the name, the line under it and the role.

user-card-name-text.$description: User card: the name (the card's heading).

user-card-name-font-family.$description: User card: the name's typeface (a heading).

user-card-name-font-size.$description: User card: the name's size (default variant).

user-card-name-line-height.$description: User card: the name's line height.

user-card-secondary-text.$description: User card: the line under the name (title, team or email), secondary text.

user-card-secondary-line-height.$description: User card: the line's line height.

user-card-role-margin-block-start.$description: User card: the extra space above the role badge (with the text gap, one sm step).

user-card-actions-gap.$description: User card: the space between actions.

user-card-cover-bleed-block.$description: User card with a cover: the cover reaches the card's top edge (minus the card's padding).

user-card-cover-bleed-inline.$description: User card with a cover: the cover reaches the card's side edges.

user-card-cover-radius.$description: User card with a cover: the cover's top corners, inside the card's corners.

user-card-cover-avatar-overlap.$description: User card with a cover: the avatar rises over the cover's lower edge by half its size (64px avatar), past the card's gap.

user-card-cover-avatar-ring-color.$description: User card with a cover: the ring around the avatar in the card's surface, so it stands apart from the cover.

user-card-cover-avatar-ring-width.$description: User card with a cover: the ring's width.

user-card-compact-gap.$description: Compact user card: the space between the avatar, the text and the actions.

user-card-compact-name-font-size.$description: Compact user card: the name's size (the card title's size).
